claim_text: Across each Asset, we promote responsible water use through efficiency, reuse and recycling and aim to return unconsumed water back to the catchment at the same or better quality than when it was extracted.
metric_name: Water reused / recycled; Motheo water intensity; MATSA water intensity
value_unit: ML; tonnes of water per tonne of ore processed; tonnes of water per tonne of ore processed
context_text: Across each Asset, we promote responsible water use through efficiency, reuse and recycling and aim to return unconsumed water back to the catchment at the same or better quality than when it was extracted.；Group operational water performance Water reused / recycled 3,543ML.；At Motheo a 1-in-236-year event resulted in our open-pits being inundated. Extensive dewatering was required before mining activities could resume. As a result, water withdrawal increased to 10,023 megalitres (ML), compared to 4,399ML in FY24. Motheo reported a water intensity of 1.4 tonnes of water per tonne of ore processed. MATSA also experienced prolonged periods of rainfall, making it one of the wettest years of the past decade, including the wettest March in 45 years in Spain. MATSA’s underground mining activities were not impacted by the heavy rainfall to the same extent as the open pit operations of Motheo, achieving a water intensity of 0.4 tonnes of water per tonne of ore processed.
label: Partially Supported
rationale_short: 报告提供了回用水量和两个矿山的水强度数据，能部分支撑“efficiency, reuse and recycling”，但没有提供关于“return ... at the same or better quality”的量化证据，也缺少跨资产效率改善趋势。
notes: 证据合并自水管理正文与水绩效表。
llm_reason: The claim asserts that across each asset, the company promotes responsible water use through efficiency, reuse and recycling, and aims to return unconsumed water at the same or better quality. The evidence only states 'We aim to return water to the environment at the same or better quality than when it was extracted,' which is a restatement of part of the claim without providing any factual support for actions taken, results achieved, or specific practices across each asset. There is no evidence of efficiency, reuse, recycling, or any substantive verification of the claim's material assertions.
